cac:Consignment.cbc:SummaryDescription: Park benches and spare side frames on 25 pallets.
cac:Consignment.cbc:Remarks: Received in apparent good order; seals XU-CL-77310 on the trailer doors.
cac:Consignment.cbc:CustomsClearanceServiceInstructions: The export is declared by the 3PL in Ferrano; the import by the distributor at the border.
cac:Consignment.cbc:DeliveryInstructions: Unload at dock 4; report to the gatehouse first.
cac:Consignment.cbc:HaulageInstructions: Wait at the warehouse until customs has released the export declaration.

cac:DeliveryTerms.cbc:SpecialTerms: The buyer's carrier presents the truck; the seller loads it.
cac:DeliveryTerms.cbc:LossRisk: The risk passes on loading at the 3PL's warehouse.

cac:CollectPaymentTerms.cbc:Note: The freight is paid by the consignee under its contract with the carrier.
